synopsis: ASAM QSQ is a standardization project seeking measurable simulation-quality metrics; it was at proposal stage in September 2025, with a proposal workshop held on 11 September 2025 [f14591, f5218, f14599]. The cited project is dated 2025, and the corpus consistently describes it as emerging, under development and unfinished in 2026 [f8325, f5585, f5073, f14591, f14599]. QSQ identifies a lack of standardized metrics for assessing simulation frameworks and models, particularly sensor simulation; the wider credibility communities agree validation is required but have not agreed on metrics [f8952, f9357]. The booklet includes QSQ among its main simulation-credibility references, but characterizes these frameworks as on-road and pre-standard and explicitly says QSQ is not proven off-road [f8323, f14600].
